description: Employer-authorized reads over the job-local Native Forms quiz module of Project To-dos. resource selects the read: forms (job library; jobId), form (one form with draft + published versions; formId), results (attempt summaries; jobId+formId), attempt (ONE attempt with submitted answers, grading rows, revision history, release state, and the sanitized expected-answer projection for auto-graded questions — never exposed to workers; attemptId), roster and export-csv (jobId+formId). Worker emails are never included. Requires project_todos:read scope, a claimed account, and the default-off project-todos agent surface.
name: opentrain_read_project_todo_quizzes
